audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 with 53.71% over 633 games and an all-Taliyah chart — Taliyah bullies the weak early lane and out-rotates the scaling; his threat is the Flux-root combo and item spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gave rows 3-4 to Skill and rows 5-6 to Ryze while content win[] and the packet chart read Taliyah on all seven rows.
audit.why: Content and packet agree; kit supports it — his Realm Warp is utility, his clear is mana-limited, and Taliyah keeps tempo priority even into his item spikes.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side moved to Taliyah with rewritten whys; rows 0-2 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] labeled Rune Prison as his E — Rune Prison is his W; the root only procs through Spell Flux (E). Cooldowns field had no digit and the packet flagged zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Kit: W Rune Prison 11-9s, roots only if Flux is on the target; E Spell Flux 3.5-2.5s; Q Overload 5s with resets from other casts; R Realm Warp 180/160/140s.
audit.corrected: Slot corrected; Flux-first sequencing written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d.
Rewritten with 11s W, E-orb warning, 180s R.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. It governs your forward steps. - W Seismic Shove spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and only roots through an active Spell Flux — the E orb landing on you is the one-second warning to step off. His Q resets on every other cast, so never brawl long: take the geometry trade and leave. His 180s Realm Warp tries to out-rotate a champion with a wall.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Ryze clears with single-target spells — a hard Q-shoved crash leaves him seconds behind the wave, and that gap is a free wall-surf bot or to his blue.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His root needs Flux first — your W held for that window flings him out of his own E-W-Q chain; spent on poke, you eat the full combo instead.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan to side lanes; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you plan to roam.

edits.before: Ahead, multiply: crash waves, wall-surf to every lane, and seed stones at each objective — a roaming Taliyah lead compounds faster than any lane bully's.
edits.after: Ahead, multiply: crash waves, wall-surf to every lane, and seed stones at objectives — Ryze is tethered to stacking farm, and he cannot answer a single roam.

edits.before: Land E (Rune Prison) root then chain Q (Overload) for a combo
edits.after: Land Spell Flux then W (Rune Prison) root into Q (Overload)

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave; his mana-starved trades cannot answer and his stacking rhythm slips.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Level 6 is a straight upgrade for you: Realm Warp does nothing in a duel while Weaver's Wall wins the map.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's beats his Tear-and-Rod path — poke him out of lane before the E-Q-Q rune combo ever comes online.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late his DPS spikes, but you keep priority: faster clear, faster rotations, and a wall he must respect. Never eat the root.
